justification: The strongest shared content is avian imagery: A has profile birds among other animal and abstract signs, while B has an avian-headed or winged standing figure with feathered wings, both using outline and repeated internal lines for details. The biggest difference is the iconographic scheme: B is a single large winged anthropomorphic figure interacting with a stylized plant/tree, whereas A is a crowded register-like field of separate animals, birds, abstract bands, and signs with no comparable central figure-tree relationship.
